name: Tooba Support Final Reply to Slack Thread v1

nodes.name: 🔔 Inbox Outlook Trigger
nodes.notes:
Branch A — incoming customer emails.
No subject filter here — Normalize Incoming Email filters by exact subject 'tooba feedback'.
output:raw passes full Graph API payload (id, body, from, sender, replyTo, ccRecipients, isDraft, conversationId, webLink).
TODO: Select Microsoft Outlook OAuth2 credential.

nodes.name: 📧 Normalize Incoming Email
nodes.notes:
Filters: exact subject 'tooba feedback' only, no isDraft, valid senderEmail, cleanBody >= 3 chars.
Returns [] to stop execution for any invalid/non-matching email.
Priority for customer email: replyTo → ccRecipients (external) → explicit Email: line → 'Отправлено от …' → from → sender.

nodes.name: 💬 Post Request to Slack
nodes.notes:
Posts incoming request card to #support_ai_test (C0ATU9ZD2UF).
Response .ts is used as thread_ts for sent-reply tracking.
TODO: Change C0ATU9ZD2UF to your production channel ID when ready.
TODO: Select Slack credential (type: slackApi, Bot token xoxb-…).

nodes.name: 🧷 Store Slack Thread Mapping
nodes.notes:
Saves conversationId → { channelId, threadTs, requestId, senderEmail, … } in $getWorkflowStaticData('global').
Also maintains processedIncomingMessageIds ring-buffer (max 500).
Branch A ends here.

nodes.name: 📤 Sent Outlook Trigger
nodes.notes:
Branch B — manager sent replies.
Polls Sent Items (SentItems well-known folder name in Microsoft Graph).
output:raw passes full payload including toRecipients, sentDateTime, conversationId.
TODO: Select the same Microsoft Outlook OAuth2 credential as Branch A.
TODO: If 'SentItems' folder name does not work in n8n UI, try 'Sent Items' or 'Отправленные'.

nodes.name: 📧 Normalize Sent Reply
nodes.notes:
Looks up conversationId in staticData. Returns [] if no matching conversation (not a Tooba Feedback reply).
Strips quoted email history from body via stripQuotedHistory().
Dedup via processedSentMessageIds ring-buffer (max 500).

nodes.name: 🔎 Find Slack Thread Mapping
nodes.notes: Validates slackChannelId, slackThreadTs, sentReplyText are all present before Slack post. Returns [] otherwise.

nodes.name: 🧵 Post Final Reply to Slack Thread
nodes.notes:
Posts manager reply ONLY in thread — not in main channel.
thread_ts comes from conversationId→threadTs mapping stored in Branch A.
TODO: Select Slack credential.
TODO: If thread_ts does not appear under otherOptions in your n8n version, move it to additionalFields.

main.node: 🧵 Post Final Reply to Slack Thread
